note: Rows of the direct Wasm target that fail when built with --wasm-memory64 (tests/conformance.py --wasm-memory64 --targets wasm-direct): one gap shared with 32-bit memory and three contracts written for 32-bit counts. Three gaps of known-gaps.json pass with 64-bit memory and are not here: packed_layout_boundaries, regions/d8577df2d9 and uleb_length_boundaries.

causes.corpus/contracts/upstream-differential/h: Open in docs/FEATURES.md (Differences found by the upstream differential run, the limited-capacity row): an overflowing runtime-capacity push reports "array capacity exceeded" on direct Wasm, where upstream and native C say "limited array capacity exceeded".
causes.corpus/owned-struct/capacity-error/42949: With 64-bit memory a capacity of 2^32 is a count the backend holds, so the program is not stopped with "array capacity out of range" as the 32-bit contract expects (stderr_contains "capacity"); it stops where the capacity is reserved, with "data region exhausted". Same exit status and standard output.
causes.corpus/variable-enum-tail/capacity-error: With 64-bit memory a capacity of 2^32 is a count the backend holds, so the program is not stopped with "array capacity out of range" as the 32-bit contract expects (stderr_contains "capacity"); it stops where the capacity is reserved, with "data region exhausted". Same exit status and standard output.
causes.corpus/runtime-limited/errors/1: With 64-bit memory the runtime capacity read from input is a count the backend holds; the program stops where it is reserved, with "data region exhausted", not with a message that names the capacity. Same exit status and standard output.
